post.text: Finding Tech opportunities so you don’t have to!👩🏾‍💻  Today’s opportunity is with Outreachy who support people from underrepresented backgrounds get into tech!  Follow for more x  #techcareer #internship #techjobs #student #womenintech

scenes.said: It's difficult to get experience
in tech when all
all the job roles want you
to have experience before you get there,
but I'm an admission to help you find tech
opportunities you can mention
on your CV with a focus on
the ones that are free. Today we've got Outreachy. It's a fully
remote paid internship where you work on
real tech projects with experienced
mentors and you don't need to
be a uni student to apply.
Over three months you'll
contribute
to an open source project and you'll
receive a
$7 ,000 stipend. This isn't just targeted as software engineers, there are also projects
for data science, UX, UI design and a couple more you can check on the website.
Now for who can apply. Outreachy
is designed for people who are underrepresented in tech and you need to be at least 18 and able to commit at least 30 hours a week during the internship. They
have two cohorts with
applications for the next
one opening in August.
So here's what I recommend you do before then.
Check out the eligibility roles to make sure you qualify.
Sign up for the mailing list so you get an email once
the applications open and
prepare for the application essay questions which are already available on the website.
Make sure you save this video
and send it to someone who's
also trying
to break into tech and
follow for more tech
opportunities.
